title: Building effective AI agents (Anthropic Engineering)
whyUseful: A builder-authored article that separates workflows (fixed code paths) from agents (model-directed loops) and describes common patterns such as prompt chaining, routing, parallelisation and orchestrator-workers.
focus: The sections on when to use agents, when to use frameworks, and the workflow patterns; skip the appendices on first read.
objectiveRelation: Supports choosing between a workflow and an agent and justifying framework use.
